questionEn: Which rationale on the topic “Chemistry and Its Problems” is chemically correct?
questionUz: “Kimyo va uning masalalari” mavzusidagi qaysi asos kimyoviy jihatdan to‘g‘ri?
choicesEn: Combining particles with a specific chemical composition
Any object of shape and size
A mixture whose composition can be changed
choicesUz: Zarrachalarni ma'lum bir kimyoviy tarkib bilan birlashtirish
Shakl va o'lchamdagi har qanday ob'ekt
explanationEn: Substance is a combination of particles with a certain chemical composition.
explanationUz: Modda - ma'lum bir kimyoviy tarkibga ega bo'lgan zarrachalarning birikmasidir.
